description: The plot illustrates the average performance of three evaluation metrics—Precision, Recall, and F1-score—across various model sizes. The x-axis is labeled "Model Size (log scale)" and employs a logarithmic scale with specific categorical tick labels at 70m, 160m, 410m, 1.0B, 1.4B, 2.8B, and 7.0B, where 'm' and 'B' represent millions and billions, respectively. The y-axis is labeled "Avg. Performance (%)" and uses a linear scale with major tick marks at intervals of 20, ranging from 20 to 80 (with the label for 40 obscured by a grey rectangle). The "Precision" metric is represented by a solid red line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it begins at approximately 78% at 70m, declines to a minimum of roughly 71% at 410m, and then gradually increases to end at approximately 76% at 7.0B. The "Recall" metric is depicted by a solid blue line with upward-pointing triangle markers, showing a continuous upward trend from approximately 8% at 70m, passing through roughly 20% at 410m, and concluding at approximately 45% at 7.0B. The "F1-score" metric is shown as a solid purple line with upward-pointing triangle markers, which also exhibits a steady increase across the x-axis, starting at approximately 14% at 70m, reaching roughly 31% at 410m, and ending at approximately 56% at 7.0B.
